terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.meta: Terms of Service for SwiftCard online shop
terms.generalContent: These Terms of Service govern the use of our online shop and the purchase of products. By placing an order, you agree to these terms. The contract language is English or German.
terms.ordersContent: An order constitutes a binding offer. The contract is concluded when we send an order confirmation by email. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel orders at our discretion, for example in cases of pricing errors or product unavailability.
terms.shippingContent: We ship within Switzerland. Delivery times are estimates only and are not guaranteed. Risk of loss transfers to the customer upon handover to the shipping carrier. Shipping costs are displayed at checkout.
terms.returnsContent: You may return unused products within 14 days of receipt. Products must be in original packaging and undamaged condition. Refunds are processed within 14 business days after we receive the returned item. Shipping costs for returns are borne by the customer.
terms.liabilityContent: We are liable only for damages caused by intent or gross negligence. Liability for indirect or consequential damages is excluded to the extent permitted by law. Product images may differ slightly from the actual product.
terms.jurisdictionContent: These terms are governed by Swiss law. The exclusive place of jurisdiction for all disputes is the registered office of our company in Switzerland.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta: Privacy Policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data
privacy.introContent: We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights under applicable data protection laws including the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.dataCollectedContent: We collect the following personal data: name, email address, shipping address, and payment information (processed securely by Stripe). We also collect technical data such as IP addresses, browser type, and device information for security and analytics purposes.
privacy.purposeContent: Your data is processed for the following purposes: order processing and fulfillment, payment processing, customer communication, fraud prevention, and service improvement. We process data based on contractual necessity and legitimate interests.
privacy.thirdPartiesContent: We use the following third-party services: Stripe (payment processing), Clerk (authentication), Vercel (hosting and infrastructure), Sentry (error monitoring), and Resend (transactional emails). Each provider processes data according to their own privacy policy.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use essential cookies required for the functioning of the shop (session management, cart, authentication). Analytics cookies are only used with your explicit consent. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time via the cookie settings in the footer.
privacy.rightsContent: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, or export your personal data. You may also object to processing or request restriction of processing. To exercise these rights, visit the "Your Data" page in your account or contact us by email.
privacy.retentionContent: Personal data is retained only as long as necessary for the purposes described. Order data is retained for 10 years as required by Swiss accounting law. You may request deletion of your account at any time; order records will be anonymized but retained for legal compliance.
privacy.contactContent: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at {email}.
